about: Byte caps on the tools/list result (compact JSON, as the stdio shim writes it) per schema profile, protocol version and role profile. Measured 2026-09-25 (WS-54); remember content made optional and the WS-19A lifecycle arguments added as Advanced 2026-09-26 (full caps grew by exactly their cost). Lower a cap when the list shrinks; never raise one to fit an addition: advertise less (declare the argument Advanced, documented at xmustard://docs/tools) or trim a description. cmd/xmustard-api checks role_profiles against the route gates.
